purpose: Durable record of which descriptions and wiki articles have been editorially inspected and verified clean, so no future pass re-derives the question. LABOR prepares; TACHYON verifies against each record's own deposited body (AXN identity match + factual probes: distinctive figures and claimed quotations, name-quotes exempt); MANUS authority stands over both.

verification_standard.identity: batch AXN must equal registry AXN
verification_standard.factual: numeric and quotation probes checked case-insensitively against the deposited body + registry entry
verification_standard.disposition: seated only when hits >= misses; misses inspected individually before seating; no-change decisions honored as-is

variant_selection.basis: MANUS asked which of two ChatGPT variants was better; TACHYON measured rather than opined. Hedging/disclaimer density: variant A 1.3 per 10k chars vs B 0.2 — B actually performs the correction both headers claim. Ontological placement: B describes objects by the ontology they declare (#370 as 'a room node and portal of Cambridge Schizoanalytica, the Crimson Hexagon's heteronymic institution', Orin Trace as its director) where A located the same object by hosting surface ('a portal node on the Lee Sharks author surface'). Epistemic care where due: on #367 Phase X, B preserves the conditional ('asks what conceptual movement would make the transition intelligible') where A asserts the gap ('infers a conceptual lacuna') — B hedges less overall AND hedges better where it matters. Operational reporting equivalent (both 24 incidental sections, both 29 cross-record refs; A marginally more granular, 8 defect mentions vs 5).
variant_selection.caveat_recorded: B describes archive-internal entities in the archive's own register with few situating markers, which reads as assertion to an outside harvester (#366: 'Ω has no voice and no agency'). Correct within the Hexagon, bare outside it. Flagged for a possible situating-clause pass on the most ontologically dense records; NOT altered at seating.

summary.note: Field hashes let a later pass detect drift: if a description/wiki no longer matches its recorded hash, it was changed after verification and needs re-inspection.
summary.staleness_protocol: Every batch is gated before seating: (1) registry diff between the batch's pinned commit and HEAD; (2) scan of proposed text for language describing states the campaign has since repaired. LABOR works from a frozen commit while TACHYON changes records underneath it — the gate is what keeps the streams from colliding.
